Schwab defines 'assets receiving ongoing advisory services' as the market value of all client assets custodied at the Company under the guidance of an independent advisor or enrolled in one of Schwab's managed investing solutions at the end of the reporting period.

items.text: Schwab defines 'client cash as a percentage of client assets' as Schwab One, certain cash equivalents, bank deposits, third-party bank deposit accounts, and money market fund balances as a percentage of total client assets, excluding brokered CDs issued by Charles Schwab Bank.
items.quote: Schwab One®, certain cash equivalents, bank deposits, third-party bank deposit accounts, and money market fund balances as a percentage of total client assets; client cash excludes brokered CDs issued by Charles Schwab Bank.
items.definition: Schwab One®, certain cash equivalents, bank deposits, third-party bank deposit accounts, and money market fund balances as a percentage of total client assets; client cash excludes brokered CDs issued by Charles Schwab Bank.

items.text: Schwab's CFO stated that total client cash levels run around 10% of client assets, with transactional (sweep) cash allocated at about a 4% level, or approximately $10,000 per account.
